description: This file defines utility methods for handling date recurrence patterns, including parsing and formatting dates, as well as managing lists of dates within the context of recurrence handling in the OfBiz framework.

classes.name: RecurrenceUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for parsing, formatting, and handling recurrence-related date operations.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object based on its length and format.

methods.name: parseDateList
methods.description: Converts a list of date strings into a list of Date objects.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string, using different patterns based on the date's components.

methods.name: formatDateList
methods.description: Converts a list of Date objects into a list of formatted date strings.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in milliseconds.
